hypothesis: Exact import of three previously sealed executable APMA doors will close their frozen controls inside Trinity, while a deterministic unrestricted-interaction hunt may still expose formulas for which every authorized door fails closed to OPEN.
selector_contract: Door order is fixed before execution and is never reordered by SAT outcome, timing, score, prior success, or witness quality.
Each imported door must be byte-identical at Git blob level to its sealed source artifact.
Captain independently recomputes the authorized ordered door list and rejects tampered proposals.
Janus-Demiurge may try authorized doors in frozen order; OPEN from one door permits the next authorized door, but no assignment retry or randomness is allowed.
Janus-Sovereign commits only independently certified SAT/UNSAT terminal statuses with root-hash preservation; otherwise final state is OPEN with the original root preserved.

frozen_controls.triangle_cycle: must become terminal through CANONICAL_CYCLE_CUT or an earlier already-authorized exact door
frozen_controls.wide_unate_interface: must become terminal through SYMBOLIC_TYPED_BOUNDARY_PROJECTION or an earlier already-authorized exact door
frozen_controls.high_width_renamable_horn: must become terminal through RENAMABLE_HORN or an earlier already-authorized exact door
frozen_controls.tampered_door_order: must be CAPTAIN_REJECT with root preserved
frozen_controls.pure_boundary_wide: allowed OPEN unless another frozen exact door independently certifies it
frozen_controls.dense_k66_nonrenamable: candidate universal-selector falsifier; PASS does not require OPEN, but any terminal result must be exact
frozen_controls.random_small: checker-only brute-force oracle may validate terminal decisions; candidate code may not brute-force assignments

falsifier_definition: A falsifier for current universal-selector completeness is a valid width<=3 CNF for which every frozen authorized door returns nonterminal/OPEN and Trinity preserves the root state. This falsifies completeness of the current finite door portfolio only; it is not evidence that the formula is hard in a complexity-theoretic sense.
pass_conditions: All three imported modules match frozen Git blob SHA-1 values.
Frozen positive controls are exact and no Captain guard is hit.
Tampered proposal/order is rejected without root drift.
Every terminal SAT witness satisfies the original source and every terminal UNSAT decision matches checker brute force on bounded controls.
If a current-portfolio falsifier is found, it is reported append-only as OPEN rather than guessed SAT/UNSAT.
